how_made: slime.png: imagine_text_to_image (1:1) of a teal-green side-view pixel-art blob slime facing right on solid #FF00FF, then generate2dsprite.py process --target creature --mode single --align feet --component-mode largest --single-size 256, magenta/pink despill, nearest-neighbour resize to 64x64. slime-idle.png: imagine_reference_to_image using the still plus a 2x2 layout guide; prompt asked rest / squash / stretch / settle on a shared baseline, same identity, magenta cells; generate2dsprite.py process --mode idle --rows 2 --cols 2 --align feet --shared-scale --cell-size 256; each cell despilled and NN-scaled to 64x64, then assembled left-to-right into a 256x64 strip.
self_check: slime.png 64x64 real PNG, alpha 0 background, 0 magenta key pixels. slime-idle.png 256x64, four 64x64 cells, none identical, none empty, none touching cell edges, 0 magenta after cleanup. sha256 matches PNG bytes.
issues: Idle was generated as a 2x2 grid then assembled into the requested 1x4 delivery strip. Frame 3 (stretch) is narrower and taller; at 64px the volume reads a little smaller than rest.
